1.text: Who is like me among the divine beings?
1.label: 4Q427 Fragment 7, Column ii

1.text: And who is [as the one prepared for] me?
And who is comparable [to me in glory]?
[...] I am a companion of the divine beings [...]
And my dwelling is [in the holy council] [...]
[...] and my [desire] is not for the glory of [f]lesh [...]
[...] not for silver and not for gold, [nor for the inheritance of] flesh [...]
[...] but for the glory of the [Most High], and to praise the [King of Holiness] [...]
Who will return [to me and compare with me]?
And who will be placed beside me in the council of the holy ones? [...]
And it shall not be said [of me], 'He has not [learned].'
For I have been reckoned among the divine beings, [and my glory] is with the [sons of the] King; [none] among the divine beings is like me [...]

2.text: [...] who is like me among the [divine beings]?
2.label: 4Q471b

2.text: [...] and who is as the one prepared [...]
[...] who will answer [me and] compare [with me]?
[...] and who will sit with me? [...]
[...] and I have been reckoned among the [divine beings] [...]
[...] on a throne of strength [...] a companion of the divine beings [...]

3.text: [...] a throne of strength in the council of [divine beings] [...]
3.label: 4Q491c Fragment 11, Column i

3.text: [...] there is none for me, and none is comparable [...]
[...] I am a companion of the divine beings [...]
